cards.title: Copper's limit moves inside the rack
cards.question: Will AI scale-up networks shift from copper to optical co-design?
cards.selfCheck: Power and reach constrain copper; test optical design wins and watts/bit.
cards.prompt: FACT: Marvell-Lumentum merger announced Nov 2, 2026; company says scale-up/scale-in is shifting toward integrated optics. Marvell acquired Celestial AI Feb 2, 2026. HYPOTHESIS: optical adoption moves closer to accelerators, creating photonics and packaging content. TEST: dated customer qualifications, power per bit, volume shipments; disconfirm if copper/AEC retains economics. 7d: no new verified design win; 30d: Nov 2 deal; 90d: expanding interconnect thesis. https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1040/marvell-and-lumentum-to-combine-creating-a-category-leader-in-ai-connectivity https://investor.marvell.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001835632-26-000019/mrvl-20260502.htm

cards.title: MRVL: more dollars per AI rack?
cards.question: Could Marvell monetize both custom XPUs and their connections?
cards.selfCheck: XPU attach adds content; test FY27 optical and switching revenue.
cards.prompt: FACT: Marvell May 13 proxy: optics roughly half of data-center revenue, custom silicon about 25%; March 5 presentation forecast FY27 1.6T ramp and switching revenue above $600M versus $300M FY26. HYPOTHESIS: integration captures more per AI rack. Not an undiscovered name; acquisition and growth widely public. TEST: reported FY27 product revenue, gross margin, customer concentration and deal dilution. https://investor.marvell.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001104659-26-060253/tm261486-1_def14a.htm https://investor.marvell.com/_assets/_de258ecc084556935b61ff8ecc599288/marvell/db/3735/35341/file/2026_03_05_Marvell_Q4_FY26_financial_business_results_FINAL.pdf

cards.title: A 2026 promise reaches FY27
cards.question: Can Marvell's earlier 1.6T and XPU-attach targets become reported sales?
cards.selfCheck: March 5 promise: FY27 ramp; test shipments, revenue mix and margins.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL DATE March 5, 2026: Marvell FY26 results forecast rapid 1.6T optical ramp, XPU attach programs ramping FY27, AEC/retimer aggregate revenue doubling FY27, switching >$600M FY27. NEW PROOF Nov 2: announced Lumentum combination and preliminary fiscal Q3 revenue in line with guidance; neither verifies those individual ramps. TEST: upcoming detailed results and customer production orders; disconfirm on slips or margin erosion. https://investor.marvell.com/_assets/_de258ecc084556935b61ff8ecc599288/marvell/db/3735/35341/file/2026_03_05_Marvell_Q4_FY26_financial_business_results_FINAL.pdf https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1040/marvell-and-lumentum-to-combine-creating-a-category-leader-in-ai-connectivity

cards.title: A huge TAM is not earnings
cards.question: Which MRVL growth assumptions survive merger dilution and integration?
cards.selfCheck: Separate organic growth from synergies; test margins and share count.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 2: MRVL-LITE all-stock deal, implied LITE enterprise value $115B; projected >$1B annual run-rate cost synergies, expected close H1 2028, 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share. These are management expectations, not realized profit. No verified current sell-side consensus or multiple: do not assert mispricing. Compare organic optical/custom growth, acquisition-related dilution, integration costs, adjusted vs GAAP EPS, and antitrust risk. https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1040/marvell-and-lumentum-to-combine-creating-a-category-leader-in-ai-connectivity

cards.title: Watch MRVL; demand proof first
cards.question: What would justify adding it to a research shortlist?
cards.selfCheck: Wait for FY27 mix and margins; reject on missed ramps or dilution.
cards.prompt: Decision framework: WATCH, not automatic buy. Upcoming proof in Marvell detailed quarterly results and 2027 customer ramps; compare forward valuation to organic EPS growth and post-deal share count before entry. Nov 2 merger is already public; do not pay for hypothetical $550B TAM. Bull: 1.6T and XPU attach shipments scale, margins resilient. Bear: design wins slip, integration/dilution overwhelms organic growth, optical adoption slower. Also compare COHR and independent optical suppliers. Sources https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1040/marvell-and-lumentum-to-combine-creating-a-category-leader-in-ai-connectivity https://investor.marvell.com/_assets/_de258ecc084556935b61ff8ecc599288/marvell/db/3735/35341/file/2026_03_05_Marvell_Q4_FY26_financial_business_results_FINAL.pdf

cards.title: Follow the revenue bridge
cards.question: How do you spot an inflection before quarterly EPS shows it?
cards.selfCheck: Trace claim → qualification → shipments → mix → margin.
cards.prompt: Teach the proof ladder with MRVL: March 5 FY27 1.6T ramp forecast; Nov 2 optical merger announcement is strategy, not shipment proof; next check design wins, production volume, reported product revenue, margin, share count. Compare with Micron March 16 HBM4 high-volume production and later financial results as a more mature proof stage. Explain why a press release and price rally alone are insufficient. https://investor.marvell.com/_assets/_de258ecc084556935b61ff8ecc599288/marvell/db/3735/35341/file/2026_03_05_Marvell_Q4_FY26_financial_business_results_FINAL.pdf https://investors.micron.com/news/press-release/2026/Micron-in-High-Volume-Production-of-HBM4-Designed-for-NVIDIA-Vera-Rubin-PCIe-Gen6-SSD-and-SOCAMM2-03-16-2026/default.aspx
